### Post 1: Full-Time Score Post
Saltcombe Rovers led early with a 2-0 advantage, but Duskvale Wanderers staged a comeback, scoring two goals in the second half. The match ended 3-2 in favor of Duskvale Wanderers. #ComebackMagic [R4]

### Post 2: Stat-of-the-Match Post
Duskvale Wanderers created no big chances but managed to score twice, reversing their fortunes. Theo Ibarra's late goal was crucial, giving them the 3-2 victory. #GameChanger [R3]

### Post 3: Turning-Point Post
The game took a dramatic turn at 45+4' with Theo Ibarra's equalizer, swaying Duskvale Wanderers' win probability from 0% to 4%. This goal showed the resilience and fighting spirit needed for a comeback! #TurningPoint [R72]
